skills.name: Single Heal
skills.description: Restores HP to a single target.

skills.name: Group Heal
skills.description: Restores HP to all party members.

skills.name: Additional Buff
skills.description: Adds flat bonus (3-5) to target's next action.

skills.name: Mana Transfer
skills.description: Transfers 5 mana to another ally target.

skills.name: Poke
skills.description: Deals damage to an enemy at the cost of 10% of own HP.

skills.name: Slam
skills.description: Deals damage to all enemies at the cost of 5% of own HP.

skills.name: Conditional Attack
skills.description: High damage, but only works if user is below 50% HP.

skills.name: Life Steal
skills.description: Deals damage and heals for 50% of damage dealt.

skills.name: Single Amplify
skills.description: Buffs ally by 125%-150%.

skills.name: Group Amplify
skills.description: Buffs all allies by 110%-120%.

skills.name: Inversion
skills.description: Flips the sign of the next action (Positive/Negative).

skills.name: Squared Power
skills.description: Choose an ally. Their next action is casted twice but at half the effectiveness for 2 TURNS.

skills.name: Single Burden
skills.description: Shares 50% damage with target.

skills.name: Group Burden
skills.description: Shares damage with team (25% for 2 allies, 15% for 3).

skills.name: Skill Cost Reduction
skills.description: Reduces HP/Mana costs by 50% for 3 turns.

skills.name: Battle Equalizer
skills.description: Choose two allies. Sums up their HP and splits it evenly between them.

skills.name: Single Drain
skills.description: Removes HP from a targeted entity.

skills.name: Life Siphon
skills.description: Removes HP from ALL entities on the field.

skills.name: Mana Steal
skills.description: Steals 5 mana from a single ally target.

skills.name: Blood Transfer
skills.description: Consumes 10% of own HP to heal an ally target.

skills.name: Sacrifice
skills.description: Consumes 5% of own HP to heal all allies on the field.

skills.name: Mana Nuke
skills.description: Deals damage to an enemy. If HP > 75%, deals extra damage based on missing mana.

skills.name: Debt Transfer
skills.description: Deals damage to an enemy and heals an ally for 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Single Reflection
skills.description: Target ally reflects 50% of the next incoming damage back to the attacker.

skills.name: Group Reflection
skills.description: All living allies reflect incoming damage. 25% each for 2, 15% each for 3.

skills.name: Unfair Battle
skills.description: Target two enemies. Sums their HP and redistributes: Boss+Mob=80/20, Mob+Mob=50/50.

skills.name: Club Smash
skills.description: A heavy club strike on a single hero.

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.description: Shakes the ground, hitting all heroes.

skills.name: Bandage
skills.description: Patches up wounds to restore HP.

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.description: Raises fighting spirit, boosting next attack.
